product_summary: Website (quessentials.in/our-products) lists: Superfoods/Seeds/Millets - Quinoa seeds, Chia seeds, Amaranth seeds, Browntop millet, Barnyard millet, Fennel seeds, Flax seeds, Foxtail millet, Jowar, Kodo millet, Little millet, Pearl millet, Proso millet, Sesame seeds, Basil seeds; Spices - Ajwain, Bay leaves, Black pepper, Cardamom, Chilli, Cinnamon, Cloves, Cumin, Fenugreek; Nuts/Dry fruits/Other - Almonds, Dry fruits, Walnuts, Peanuts. Home page additionally claims being 'largest processor of Chia seeds, flax seeds, sesame seeds, bird feed and animal feed in South India'. Facility: 25,000 sq ft processing plant near Bangalore (Malur, KIADB), 50 MT/day capacity, certifications FSSAI, ISO 22000:2018, HACCP, BRCGS, APEDA, Spice Board, USDA/NOP/NPOP.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - claims own processing facility (25,000 sq ft, 50 MT/day, cleaning/sorting) and 'Star Export House' status, but the catalogue is a broad multi-category trading range (spices + nuts + millets + superfoods) typical of an aggregator; no customs line reviewed here to confirm own-manufacture vs. third-party sourcing.
comment: Declared codes 100850 (quinoa), 100890 (other cereals), 120740 (sesame), 120799 (other oil seeds) cover only the superfoods/seeds core and are CORRECT for those items - quinoa, amaranth, sesame, chia, flax, basil all map cleanly. Status: partial. The declaration is materially incomplete: (1) the entire MILLETS line (pearl, foxtail, kodo, little, barnyard, browntop, proso, jowar/sorghum) is missing - these fall under 1008.2x/1008.29, not 100890; (2) the entire SPICES line is missing - fennel, cumin, ajwain, fenugreek, bay leaves (09xx), black pepper (0904.11), chilli (0904.21), cardamom (0908.3x), cinnamon (0906.1x), cloves (0907); (3) NUTS/DRY FRUITS missing - almonds (0802.12), walnuts (0802.31), peanuts (1202.30), dry fruits (08xx); (4) bird feed and animal feed claimed on the home page have no HS line at all (would be 1214/2306-type, or 1213 for forage) - these are a separate product family entirely absent from the declaration. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly right but understates the profile: this is an agri-commodity bulk exporter (APEDA/Spice Board registered), not an FMCG brand - industry classification should be 'agro-commodities / bulk food ingredients'. Trader signs: broad unrelated multi-category catalogue, 'Star Export House' positioning, bulk-order language ('catering to bulk orders for both domestic and international buyers'), and no product-level spec sheets or own-brand SKUs on the site - consistent with aggregator/trader behaviour alongside claimed processing. Per Rule 3, the HS gaps are NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, codes to be corrected/extended to the actual range above. All product claims here are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line was reviewed in this task, so no shipment-level corroboration of any HS code is asserted. Note also a naming inconsistency on the site itself: footer uses both 'Quessentials Private Limited' and 'Quessentials Limited' / 'Quessentials Ltd' - legal-form discrepancy to be resolved by the registry check (not in scope here).
